units.translation: 1389-90a. nor does he await the season with his rays: he said "season" in a derived form instead of "at the proper time and the fitting moment," as in "for necessity presses" (Homer). The construction in order: nor does he await being dried by the rays of the sun until the proper time.
b. 〈to be dried:〉 to be roasted. Sg
1394. 〈with his arm:〉 with his elbow. Sm
1395. build: the constitution and complexion of the body. LgP
1 χρόαν in L : χροιάν in P
1397a. they advanced: they came forward. LgSmP
b. As much as they had above the earth, so much also under the earth. Lm (P)
